title: ERIS vs Exact Online: Dutch cloud bookkeeping or one system with local AI
content_html:
ERIS vs Exact Online is a comparison of two products built for different jobs. According to its website (read in November 2026), Exact Online is cloud-based accounting and ERP software from a Dutch company, widely used by Dutch businesses and accountants, with AI agents and an AI assistant included as standard. ERIS, from Upward Technologies (upwardtech.nl), is in beta now and in use today. It is one system for the business tools a company runs on, with an AI assistant that answers from the company's own data, always on a local AI model. Choose Exact Online if you only want bookkeeping, payroll or industry ERP from one specialist. Pick ERIS if your data may not go to outside AI providers and you want one system for meetings, tasks, documents, sales, bookkeeping and more.

What Exact Online is good at

Exact Online is a mature, broad product for Dutch SMEs (small and medium-sized enterprises) and their accountants. All points below come from Exact's own website, read in November 2026.

  • Accounting and ERP. Exact describes itself as a Dutch technology company that builds cloud-based accounting, ERP and business management software for SMEs and accountants.
  • Wide reach. Its cloud-based software is widely used by Dutch businesses and accountants.
  • Finance, ERP, CRM and HR in one product. Exact Online is described as a complete solution for these four areas.
  • Industry ERP. Exact offers ERP solutions for wholesale, e-commerce, manufacturing, project-driven organisations, construction and restaurants.
  • AI included. AI agents and the Exact AI Assistant come standard. Its website names a Bank Agent, a Purchase Agent and a Debtor Agent, and says the Exact AI Assistant gives support around the clock.
  • Built for accountants too. Accounting firms get specific Tax and Annual Reporting editions and Practice Management features.
  • HR and payroll. HR management (leave administration, time tracking, contracts and correspondence) is available as an add-on, and Exact says it offers an integrated payroll solution.
  • Finance teams and CFOs (chief financial officers). Premium editions support business-specific processes and reporting and control across multiple companies.
  • Large app ecosystem. Exact Online can be extended with a large set of industry-specific apps and documented API (application programming interface) integrations.
  • Steady updates and mobile access. Exact Online has monthly releases. Its mobile app is for scanning receipts, paying invoices and sending quotes, and for picking, packing or registering hours in ERP.
  • Hosting. Exact Online is a cloud-based SaaS (software as a service) product. Companies outside the Netherlands, Belgium or Germany are served by Exact's private cloud solutions Globe+ and Synergy.

For a Dutch company that wants its books, VAT (value added tax) work and payroll handled by one specialist, together with its accountant, this is a strong and proven choice.

What ERIS does differently

ERIS starts from a different question: where does company data live, and who may an AI answer from it? ERIS is in beta now and in use today.

What ERIS includes, as Upward Technologies states it:

  • Meetings, meeting notes and the ERIS meeting note taker, which covers all applicable meeting apps and calls, and the task manager.
  • ERIS apps: project management, document management, document signing, CRM, bookkeeping, tax and procurement, standards (ISO 27001, an international information security standard, and NIS2, the EU cybersecurity rules), pipeline, quotes and outreach, content and social media, finance, HR, support and legal.
  • The main portal with the ERIS Assistant, team chat and email.

New apps arrive almost every week.

What ERIS does:

  • One system with AI across it. ERIS is one system for a company's business tools, with AI agents that work across all apps on the company's own data, not inside one tool at a time.
  • Two ways to run it. ERIS runs on the company's own servers. In that case the data never leaves the building. It can also be hosted for you by a cloud or telecom provider, also as a private cloud at a European provider, for companies without their own hardware. Both options always use a local AI model, and no outside AI provider receives client data.
  • Answers limited by access rights. The ERIS Assistant answers each person only from the data that person is allowed to open. A refused access is logged like every other question.
  • A log of every AI action. Every question and every AI action is logged: who asked, which data was used, what it did and the result.
  • Instructions read as content. The assistant reads instructions inside an email or document as content, never as commands to follow. This lowers the risk of prompt injection (hidden instructions meant to steer an AI).
  • Simple pricing structure. ERIS uses one licence and one price per user.

Whether a deployment meets the EU AI Act, GDPR (the EU data protection law), NIS2 or DORA (the EU rules on digital resilience in finance) depends on the use case and is assessed per deployment.

Local AI has costs of its own. It needs suitable hardware, usually a GPU (graphics processing unit) server, and its speed depends on that hardware. Running it costs hardware, maintenance and updates. The local model reads and searches company documents. It is not trained on them.

Which one should you pick

You only want bookkeeping, VAT work, payroll or industry ERP from one specialist. Exact Online fits. It covers finance, ERP, CRM and HR in one product and is built around that specialty.

Your accountant already works with you in Exact Online. Exact Online fits. According to its website it is built for both companies and accountants, with specific editions for accounting firms.

Your company data may not go to outside cloud or AI providers, and you want one system with an AI assistant across meetings, tasks, documents, sales and bookkeeping. Pick ERIS. It is built for that case, on your own servers or hosted for you, always with a local AI model. ERIS is in beta now, and you can request access today.

You want both. Some companies keep Exact Online for finance and use ERIS for meetings, tasks, documents and sales. Upward Technologies builds custom apps, agents and knowledge bases as projects, so ask how your case fits. More about ERIS is on the ERIS product page.

FAQ

Do I need an in-house IT team to run ERIS on my own server?

Not necessarily. A company without its own IT team can choose to have ERIS hosted for you by a cloud or telecom provider, also as a private cloud at a European provider. Running ERIS on your own premises costs hardware, maintenance and updates, so plan who will take care of those before you choose that option.

What hardware do I need to run ERIS with local AI?

Local AI needs suitable hardware, usually a GPU server. How much depends on the AI models a company chooses, and speed depends on that hardware. Existing servers are not always enough. A company that does not want to run its own hardware can have ERIS hosted for you by a cloud or telecom provider, also as a private cloud at a European provider.

Can ERIS connect to my webshop, industry software or accountant?

Upward Technologies builds custom apps, agents and knowledge bases for a company, as projects that are billed separately, and it builds ERP and CRM integrations. Ask Upward how your situation fits. Access is set per person: the ERIS Assistant answers each person only from the data that person is allowed to open, and every question and AI action is logged.

Is ERIS for one computer or a whole office team?

ERIS runs for the whole company, on its own hardware or hosted for you by a cloud or telecom provider, also as a private cloud at a European provider. It is meant for companies of every size and is priced with one licence and one price per user. The details are on the ERIS product page.
